description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the Rates of Exchange effective from 27.08.2018 to 02.09.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
